contracts.single_point_justification: Exclusions are a static pair mask; the isolated Coulomb oracle mutates only the excluded pair and checks analytic energy plus the complete force payload.

contracts.single_point_justification: The compatibility binding only activates the frame-local GB consumer; the focused hybrid oracle independently rejects activation-only and Coulomb-only behavior.
LJ soft-core parameters are consumed by a frame-local force kernel; the focused payload control changes the owned energy and complete force fingerprint.
Subsystem division is a static atom classification; the isolated partition oracle changes membership and verifies the resulting soft-core contribution.
Virtual-atom construction is an algebraic per-frame mapping; exact reconstructed coordinates and redistributed real-atom forces cover all four types.
The PBC virtual-atom contract is a per-frame minimum-image mapping; the boundary oracle distinguishes the periodic coordinate from the non-periodic result.
Stillinger-Weber is a frame-local potential; the isolated lambda mutation changes both pair/three-body energy and the complete force fingerprint.
The SW sidecar feeds the same frame-local potential; a sidecar-only lambda mutation independently changes energy and complete force.
Tersoff is a frame-local bond-order potential; the typed gamma-zero control changes angular energy and the complete force fingerprint.
The Tersoff sidecar feeds the frame-local bond-order potential; an isolated gamma mutation changes energy and complete force.
Custom pairwise definitions are frame-local expressions; the isolated analytic energy and complete-force oracle proves definition and parameter consumption.
